leagues.name: City National Arena Youth House League
leagues.governingBody: Vegas Jr. Golden Knights / City National Arena
leagues.notes: Operated at NHL Golden Knights' official practice facility; weekly game schedule and standings via SportsEngine; multiple seasons per year

leagues.name: Las Vegas Ice Center Youth House League
leagues.notes: Year-round program; USA Hockey registration required; $750 (8U) / $915 (10U–HS); feeds into LV Storm travel tryouts

leagues.name: SoBe Ice Warriors Recreational League
leagues.notes: 8 regular-season games + 1 guaranteed playoff game per season; not-for-profit; also fields competitive travel teams

leagues.name: Reno Ice City League
leagues.notes: Weekly practices and weekend games; summer 5v5 league sessions also offered May–Jun; travel arm competes in NorCal Youth Hockey

leagues.name: NorCal Youth Hockey Association — A
leagues.notes: Reno Ice confirmed in 12U A division (12-3-1 record as division leader 2025-26); league also has AA / BB / B tiers; regional league based on seasonal schedules and standings

leagues.name: Arizona Youth Hockey League (AZYHL) — Pinnacle
leagues.notes: LV Storm 10U AA (10U Pinnacle/Cactus division) and 12U AA (12U Pinnacle) confirmed 2025-26; top competitive tier; includes Las Vegas Ice Center venue

leagues.name: Arizona Youth Hockey League (AZYHL) — Cactus
leagues.notes: LV Storm 12U A (Cactus) and 14U A (Cactus) confirmed 2025-26; second tier within AZYHL structure

leagues.name: Arizona Youth Hockey League (AZYHL) — Mesquite
leagues.notes: LV Storm 10U A (Mesquite) confirmed 2025-26; third competitive tier in AZYHL; Canyon tier also exists below Mesquite

leagues.name: Pacific Girls Hockey League (PGHL)
leagues.notes: Vegas Jr. Golden Knights and Las Vegas Storm both confirmed 2025-26 members; 13 clubs across 4 states; PGHL is Pacific regional affiliate of National Girls Hockey League (NGHL); season opened Sep 13 2025

leagues.name: Tier 1 Elite Hockey League (T1EHL)
leagues.notes: Vegas Jr. Golden Knights 10U AAA (95.5 rating) / 11U AAA / 12U AAA all confirmed 2025-26; showcase-based national format; 20+ clubs coast to coast

leagues.name: T1ER League (North American T1ER Hockey League)
leagues.notes: Vegas Jr. Golden Knights 14U AAA / 15U AAA / 16U AAA all confirmed 2025-26; nationally bound format for USA Hockey Tier I elite teams
